pos.personaBrief: Holding Midfield: quick direct football, deep defence, counter space for the 3Rs; Gilberto Silva anchoring.

pro.personaBrief: Quick, direct football, long balls to Ronaldo behind the last man, safe holding midfielders, fast attack.

est.personaBrief: Front three free to roam and swap, Ronaldo isolated as poacher, while back three and wing-backs keep a defined shape.

lar.personaBrief: 3-5-2 built to free Cafu and Roberto Carlos; front three narrow, wing-backs supply width, no wide wingers.

blo.personaBrief: Defence sat deep relying on numbers, countering; pressing selective, Ronaldo exempt from marking duty.

mar.personaBrief: No source names marking system; Scolari's pragmatic back three with cover, tall defenders, mixed approach leaning zone.

pla.personaBrief: Imposed a back three and own identity, adjusted by removing Juninho for a holding midfielder, little opponent-specific plan.

res.personaBrief: Pragmatic winner: balance, solid back three, seven wins; result over show.

sis.personaBrief: Built around the 3Rs with freedom, Ronaldo spared defending, but a balanced solid structure behind them.

jog.personaBrief: Tall defenders, unfashionable dogged midfielders, but technical stars up front; Juninho dropped for balance.

bas.personaBrief: National squad of veterans of 1998 final; left out Romario but chose experienced Cafu, Roberto Carlos, Rivaldo, Ronaldo.

lid.personaBrief: Familia Scolari, father figure, but boss who dropped Romario and Djalminha and picked leaders.
